comments: c32a5e70: This program is used to print reports for various summary types within a specified date range and division.
4e918839: If multiple divisions are allowed, prompt for division selection.
ba5b32bb: If multiple divisions are not allowed, use the first division in the file.
eb23d0bd: Execute the report type logic specified in DGJTL.
63631bf7: Prompt for the date range for the report.
6ab1d8e7: Limit the report to specific summary types: OP Report, Interim Summary, and Discharge Summary.
e5c5ac91: Prompt for the selection of one or more summary types for the report.
fc928805: Display a message indicating that the report requires a printer capable of 132 column output.
e191144e: Get the current date and time, format it for display, and store it in DGJTDAT.
d716fabb: Set up variables for the report, prepare for device handling, and start the report output if a device was selected successfully.
e3024709: Exit the routine.
4cb56e0b: ;Loop through IFNs in ^VAS(393) and perform checks with CK subroutine.
9d5145a1: ;If the current page is either 1 or 3 and ^UTILITY("VAS",$J) is defined, initialize variables and go to DGJOTP2.
b703b32d: ;If the current page is 2 and ^UTILITY("VAS",$J) is defined, initialize variables and go to DGJOTP3.
961bb1f8: ;Display message if no records are found in ^UTILITY("VAS",$J).
a66c7603: ;Go to QUIT label in DGJOTP routine.
9cb4e7c0: ;Calculate the total of DGJT2PC, DGJT3PC, and DGJT4PC and store in DGJT5PC.
5493fff8: ;Increment total records for DGJTDVN and increment records over 30 days if DGJT5PC is greater than 30.
adda6316: ;For physician (PHY) records, initialize DGJPHTOT for DGJTDVN and DGJTPHY if not set and increment totals, including those over 30 days if DGJT5PC is greater than 30.
56bfadf4: ;If the record type is PHY, call PC subroutine and then quit.
f5430412: ;For service (SER) records, initialize DGJSVTOT for DGJTDVN and DGJTSV if not set and increment totals, including those over 30 days if DGJT5PC is greater than 30, then call PC subroutine.
f0e38ddc: ;If the record type is SER, initialize DGJSPTOT for DGJTDVN, DGJTSV, and DGJTSP if not set and increment the count.
a030d84d: ;Quit the current subroutine.
51213538: ;Check if division is selected or if the division of the record is not in the selected divisions then quit.
19f818e4: ;If a specific division is selected and the division of the record does not match, then quit.
d16bf1d0: ;If the service related indicator is set to 'service connected only' and the record is not marked as service connected, then quit.
b5c89b56: ;If the service related indicator is set to 'non-service connected only' and the record has any service connection status, then quit.

4c9c9f30: ;If not filtering by service related status and the document type is 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY', check if there is a corresponding patient movement. If there is none or the movement does not have a discharge date, then quit.
167f0529: ;Set the piece number of the node where the provider's name is stored based on the document type.
b35987f5: ;Quit if there is no document type, the document type is not found, or if the document type is not one of the types to be included.
042d8adc: ;If provider is selected and this provider is not in the selected list, then quit.
f9a8bf2b: ;Exit if facility filter is on and record's facility is not selected.
14b06133: ;Exit if service filter is on and record's service is not selected.
c84af552: ;Exit if the procedure date is outside the specified range.
584b1336: ;Call routine to pull inpatient/outpatient data and exit if record is not found.
b67bc0eb: ;Set division name, defaulting to 'NOT SPECIFIED' if not found, except for service reports where division totals aren't tracked.
0e4d80b9: ;For service reports, truncate division name to 23 characters and initialize total if not already set.
c193154f: ;Retrieve patient name from the PATIENT file if it exists.
8e7acced: ;For physician reports, set the physician name and organize data by division, physician, patient, and ifn; then count the record.
750e71ee: ;Set DGJTSV to the service name if it exists and is valid, otherwise to 'NOT SPECIFIED'. Set DGJTSP to the specialty name if it exists and is valid, otherwise to 'NOT SPECIFIED'.
62d51f96: ;Trim service, specialty, and patient type to 16 characters and store in ^UTILITY global with demographics and code info, then call CNT.
0ba7fb44: ;End of procedure.
da0a2ea6: ;Update the total percentages for 2nd, 3rd, and 4th levels of care based on DGJTL.
bda7c2ac: ;Update the physician total with the new percentages if DGJTL is 'PHY'.
af28571e: ;Update the service total with the new percentages if DGJTL is 'SER'.
4e9eefd7: ;Exit the procedure.
102e4cea: ;Calculate the new totals and adjust the 7th piece of DGJJX based on the sum of 2nd, 3rd, and 4th levels exceeding 30.
477d1f58: ;Return from TOT subroutine.
2cbef471: ;Initiate variables for physician selection and manage selection process; set flag if selection is unsuccessful.
bea1dd8d: ;Return from PHY subroutine.
61d9a2ca: ;Initiate variables for service selection and manage the selection process.
fb455f40: ;Initiate variables for specialty selection and manage the selection process.
55a3b839: ;Return from SER subroutine.
